placements.text:
Ten short films imagining the food truck we want to build. One Tail One Meal wants to reach street animals in every country, and it starts in Cairo. The plan: every morning, leftovers from neighbourhood butchers become a warm meal for street animals, served on a plate they can eat. None of this is running yet; this is what we're raising money to build.

No stray should go hungry. Help us build the first truck: onetailonemeal.com
